column1: # gVisor (Apache-2.0) release the docker-gvisor cell host installs: runsc and
# containerd-shim-runsc-v1 from the release archive, verified against the
# SHA-512 pinned here before anything is unpacked. The published .sha512 next
# to the archive is checked too, but it comes from the same origin, so the pin
# is what proves the bytes. Bump the release, both digests and the date
# together, never to a release younger than two weeks.
# Columns: release, arch (uname -m), sha512 of gvisor.tar.bz2, published (UTC).
